title.narrative: Strengthening Capacities for Green, Inclusive Economic Growth 2.0

description.narrative: This one-year project initiation plan aims to prepare the foundation for a National Implementation Modality (NIM) project to be implemented from 2025-2028 with the goal of strengthening capacities of institutions to develop and implement gender responsive national and local development plans, which are linked to budgets and supported by data for enhanced productivity and improved local economic development. It also aims to enhance capacities of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to access finance, digital and business development services, and leverage Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) opportunities, to create sustainable livelihoods and employment. Furthermore, the project will enable national and sub-national institutions to provide access to inclusive and sustainable social protection services for the poor especially women, youth and persons with disabilities particularly those in the rural and marginalized communities. Finally, the project will continue to support the enhancement of conducive environments such that government, development partners, private sector Docusign Envelope ID: 78A0BE00-ECE8-4835-963F-210189F46C07and the diaspora are better coordinated to contribute to sustained development financing, and effective partnership for integrated implementation of the NDP, SDGs and AU Agenda 2063.
